glomeris actions — Registered actions, or the real-execution audit log.

usage: glomeris actions <list|history> [--json] [--limit <N>]

Read-only — changes nothing.

`actions list` shows every action this binary has registered — the closed
set an LLM plan or an `execute` call can select from, and nothing else.
`actions history` shows a bounded tail of the audit log of real executions:
what ran, against what, and how it ended.

Options
  list
      Show the registered actions and which resource kind each applies to.
  history
      Show a bounded tail of the real-execution audit log.
  --limit <N>
      For `history`: how many of the most recent records to show.
  --json
      Print the report as JSON on stdout.

Examples
  glomeris actions list
      What is Glomeris even able to do?
  glomeris actions history --limit 10
      What has it actually done to this machine?

See also: execute, history
